answer: Every newcomer must bring one ship into the harbor under a licensed pilot. The pilot logs the transit and the harbor master checks it against the tide table; a grounding voids the claim and burns a 600 POA bond. The garden beside the quay grows the rope the pilot trusts, the lighthouse marks the channel at its zenith, and one transit costs $410, so 100 fakes need 100 transits, $41,000 and 60,000 POA in bonds; honest pilots keep the haven.
